page.overview:
What is Huff Darklighter's personal security force?

Huff Darklighter's personal security force was a private security force created by Huff Darklighter on the planet Tatooine. Some members wore stormtrooper armor which was stained dark blue to match the color of their uniforms.

In 7.5 ABY, former members of Rogue Squadron wore the security force's variant of stormtrooper armor – which they had procured from Huff – during an operation on Elshandruu Pica, as part of the Bacta War.
